title: Through Object In
description: Through object in sends the camera into a cup, keyhole, speaker, or mouth, matter as a door, then arrives on the subject. Scale often changes along a coherent 3D route that a physical camera could not take.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Enter through a thing. Impossible reveals, jokes, a house tour that ignores walls: the named object is the door, not a generic wall.
Objects must keep thickness and shape during the passage. A cut from a cup to a face is not this.
Flying-cam transition punches architecture; this punches a prop. The practical task is continuity of space.

sections.title: In film

blocks.text: Panic Room explores a townhouse through physically inaccessible openings. Fight Club opens from microscopic neural imagery into the narrator's predicament.
The Secret in Their Eyes passes from aerial into a crowd as if continuous. Being John Malkovich treats a portal as a door in a thing.

sections.title: Prompt it

blocks.text: Name the object and the arrival. Still: Through-object-in on [Subject], the camera entering via a cup, keyhole, speaker, or mouth, matter as a door.
Video: The camera travels into an object and arrives on [Subject] on the other side. Keep thickness.
One continuous move.

A single virtual camera glides from a dark kitchen, through the narrow handle opening of a kettle, across the room and through a keyhole into a lit study. Rigid continuous architecture, physically coherent perspective, controlled acceleration, no melting surfaces. Previsualize the route in 3D and use generated textures or plates rather than relying on one unconstrained generation.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: The usual wrong cousin is a cut from a cup to a face. The tell: no interior of the object, no thickness.
The fix: travel through the named prop, keep its shape, arrive on the far side.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Through Object In in film?
Through object in is a continuous camera path that enters via a named object (keyhole, cup, speaker, mouth) and arrives on the subject, often changing scale.
Through Object In vs Pass Through
Pass-through uses architecture or a body. Through-object-in uses a named prop as the door and often includes a scale change.
When should I use Through Object In?
Use it to enter a scene through a thing: a joke, an impossible house tour, a portal. Do not fake it with a cut.
How do I prompt Through Object In for AI image or video?
Name the object, the travel, and the arrival. Example: Through-object-in on [Subject], the camera entering via a cup, keyhole, speaker, or mouth, matter as a door.
